_REQUIRED_USER_INPUT_BEFORE_USE: Replace translators[0].envs.OLLAMA_HOST to match your actual Docker topology before first use.
Replace translators[0].envs.OLLAMA_MODEL with a model that is already installed in your local Ollama.
If Ollama runs on the same host as Docker Desktop, start with http://host.docker.internal:11434.
If you are on Linux and host.docker.internal does not resolve, add host-gateway mapping in Docker or use a service name on the same Docker network.

Use this file only after OpenAI and then BabelDOC/precise have already been organized, because local Ollama introduces extra Docker networking variables and may reduce translation quality depending on the local model.
_QUALITY_NOTE: This file is for later evaluation, not for the first quality-critical mathematical-paper production path.
If you want to compare local models fairly, keep OpenAI + precise outputs as the benchmark reference.
_RUNTIME_REMINDERS: Do not leave OLLAMA_HOST as http://127.0.0.1:11434 unless Ollama is actually running inside the same container, which is not the normal setup.
For the first test, keep pages to First or a very small range and keep threads low.
If the GUI cannot connect, validate Docker networking before changing translation options.
_GUI_FIELDS_NOT_CONTROLLED_BY_THIS_FILE: Translation Mode (fast/precise) is still a manual GUI choice in stable 1.x.
number of threads is a GUI runtime textbox and is not prefilled from this file.
Pages and Ignore cache are runtime GUI choices.
_MATH_PAPER_NOTES: For mathematical papers, the direct Ollama path should be treated as a later optimization or independence step, not the first path to trust.
Local-model quality varies substantially; validate on a first page before trusting full-document mathematical notation preservation.
If final fidelity matters more than self-hosting purity, keep OpenAI as the benchmark even when evaluating Ollama.
_FORMULA_REGEX_SOURCE_NOTE: Stable 1.x GUI persists the Custom formula font regex through PDF2ZH_VFONT.
This helps reduce accidental translation of formula glyph runs in math-heavy PDFs.
_STABLE_GUI_LIMITATIONS_FOR_LOCAL_MODELS: Stable 1.x GUI does not expose enough advanced BabelDOC tuning knobs to make a weak local model behave like a strong hosted model purely through configuration.
Because of that, Ollama quality evaluation should focus on side-by-side comparison against OpenAI + precise on the same first page.
